about: Calendar date facts independently transcribed from original publications on 2026-11-06. These are narrow samples, not community approval or comprehensive observance validation. No newspaper articles or PDFs are bundled.
verification: Original PDF text and the official HTML table were inspected through the web reader. Executor PDF downloads were blocked by a proxy; MOI screenshot fetches timed out. No new byte checksums are claimed.

myco.scope: Single-day holidays give an exact date; first/last-day entries give only an inclusive holiday window.

lunar_sample_scope: The publications establish Burmese lunar-date mappings. The phase field applies this project's existing eighth-day rule; these are not published uposatha announcements or astronomical quarter-phase measurements. No new-moon sample was established.

myco_2026_thadingyut_window.comparison: The aviation AIC fixture publishes 2026-10-26 through 2026-10-27. Different holiday windows do not identify different exact full moons.
